description: This Java source file defines an abstract class EntityIdWithType that implements entity ID handling with type awareness, including equality checks, compatibility validation, and string representation. It is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.entity.id package.

classes.name: EntityIdWithType
classes.description: An abstract class representing entity IDs that are aware of their entity type, providing methods for equality, compatibility checks, and string representation.

methods.name: createEqualityValidator
methods.description: Creates a Consumer that validates equality of EntityIdWithType instances against an expected ID, deprecated in favor of isCompatibleOrThrow.

methods.name: isCompatibleOrThrow
methods.description: Checks if another EntityIdWithType is compatible with this one, throwing an exception if not.

methods.name: getIllegalArgumentExceptionForDifferentEntityIds
methods.description: Generates an IllegalArgumentException indicating two entity IDs are not compatible.
